definitions.description: Ki points power Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, and Stunning Strike.
Sorcery points fuel Metamagic options and can be converted to spell slots via Flexible Casting.
Channel Divinity grants a domain-specific effect: once between rests, twice from 6th level and three times from 18th. Regains all uses on a short or long rest.
Channel Divinity grants an oath-specific effect. Regains all uses on a short or long rest.
A pool of healing equal to 5 x your paladin level. Touch a creature to restore hit points from it, or spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. No effect on undead and constructs.

Until the end of your next turn, know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet not behind total cover, and any consecrated or desecrated place or object. 1 + your Charisma modifier uses.
Transform into a beast you have seen before. Regains uses on a short or long rest. Archdruid (20th level): an unlimited number of times.
Regain 1d10 + fighter level HP as a bonus action.
Take one additional action on your turn. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest.
Inspire an ally with a die (d6 at levels 1-4, d8 at 5-9, d10 at 10-14, d12 at 15+). Regains on short rest starting at 5th level.

Once per day when you finish a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level of up to half your wizard level (rounded up), none of 6th level or higher. Used from the short rest dialog.

Enter a rage for 1 minute. Advantage on STR checks/saves, bonus melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. 2 rages at 1st level, 3 at 3rd, 4 at 6th, 5 at 12th, 6 at 17th, unlimited at 20th.
Superiority dice that fuel combat maneuvers: four d8s at 3rd level, five at 7th, six at 15th; d10s from 10th level and d12s from 18th. Regain all on a short or long rest.
Magical arrow shots with special effects. Regain all uses on a short or long rest.
Psionic Energy dice (d6, d8 at 5th level, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th) that fuel psionic powers. Regain all on a long rest; Psionic Recovery regains one as a bonus action.
As a bonus action, regain one expended Psionic Energy die; once, then a short or long rest.
Gain temporary HP and advantage on weapon attacks until the end of this turn.
Grow to Large size, advantage on STR checks/saves, bonus damage once per turn for 1 minute.
When taking the Attack action, make one additional melee attack from your echo's position.
Mark a creature you hit. While marked and within 5ft, it has disadvantage on attacks against others. You get a bonus-action special attack against marked targets.
Roll 1d8 and add it to a creature's AC against an attack. If it still hits, the creature gains resistance to the attack's damage.
Detect the presence of magic within 60 feet for 10 minutes.
Grant a creature a d3 bonus to attack rolls or ability checks, or restore a 1st-level spell slot.
Force a creature hit by your Bestial Soul to make a WIS save or take 2d12 psychic damage and attack a target of your choice.
Unleash a battle cry. Allies within 60 feet gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Cast Command as a bonus action every turn for 1 minute without expending a spell slot. Creatures auto-succeed if already charmed.
Impose disadvantage on an attacker within 30 feet that you can see.
When hit by a creature within 5 feet, deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (DEX save for half).
Make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Detect undead within 60 feet that aren't behind total cover or warded against divination.
Turn a critical hit against a creature within 30 feet into a normal hit.
Forge a bond among up to PB creatures for 10 minutes. Bonded creatures can roll a d4 and add it to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw once per turn.
Share your darkvision out to 300 feet with up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum one) willing creatures for 1 hour; once, then a long rest (or expend a spell slot to share it again).
Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. Usable only in dim light or darkness.
Touch one nonmagical suit of armor or weapon. Until the end of your next long rest, it becomes a +1 magic item.
Cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action.
During a short rest, recover expended spell slots of combined level up to half your druid level (rounded up).
Heal a creature you can see within 120 feet. Spend dice (d6s) from this pool. Each die heals 1 HP + the die's result.
Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Summon a spirit totem that grants an aura for 1 minute. Choose Bear (temp HP), Hawk (advantage on attacks), or Unicorn (healing on spell cast).
Cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot. The number of free casts equals your proficiency bonus.
Use Weal (add d6 to ally's roll) or Woe (subtract d6 from enemy's roll). Which omen is available depends on the current star configuration rolled at the end of each long rest.
When a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet, animate it with 1 HP. It acts immediately after your turn for 1 hour or until your Symbiotic Entity ends.
When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your wildfire spirit, wreathe it in spectral flames. A creature you choose within 30 feet regains 2d10 HP or takes 2d10 fire damage.
Regain hit points equal to 3x your monk level.

Replace one attack with a breath weapon in a 20-ft cone or 30-ft line (5-ft wide), dealing damage of your draconic type (2 rolls of your Martial Arts die). Free uses = PB; additional uses cost 2 ki each.
Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn.
Cast Etherealness as a bonus action without expending a spell slot. Lasts until the start of your next turn.
Gain a flying speed of 10 feet and hover for 1 minute.
Learn a creature's damage immunities, resistances, and vulnerabilities. The target must be within 60 feet and you must see it.
Psionic Energy dice (d6, d8 at 5th level, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th) used for psionic powers. Regain all on a long rest; Psionic Recovery regains one as a bonus action.
As a bonus action, regain one expended Psionic Energy die; once, then a short or long rest.
When you deal Sneak Attack damage, deal half your Sneak Attack dice (rounded up) as necrotic damage to a second creature within 30 feet.
When a creature dies within 30 feet, capture a soul trinket (PB max). Destroy a trinket to ask the spirit one question, gain advantage on death saves, or gain advantage on a CON save.
Add 2d4 to a failed saving throw or missed attack roll, potentially turning it into a success.
Gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Refreshes when the DM forces a Wild Magic Surge.
When reduced to 0 HP, make a CHA save (DC 5 + damage taken). On success, drop to 1 HP instead.
Negate advantage or disadvantage on a d20 roll made by a creature you can see within 60 feet.
Force creatures in a 10-ft cube originating from you to make a WIS save or become charmed or frightened until the end of your next turn.
When you take damage, turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet. Invisibility lasts until the start of your next turn or until you attack/cast.
Curse a creature for 1 minute. You gain bonus damage equal to proficiency bonus, crit on 19-20, and the cursed target heals you when it dies.
Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw you make.
Impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you. If it misses, your next attack against that creature has advantage.
Heal a creature you can see within 60 feet. Spend up to CHA mod dice (d6s) from this pool per use.
Summon a spectral tentacle at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. It deals 1d8 cold damage on a hit and reduces speed by 10 feet.
Transform for 1 minute. Gain 1d10+warlockLevel temp HP, immunity to frightened, and once per turn your attack can force a WIS save vs frightened.
Enter your Genie's Vessel for up to PB x 2 hours. You can hear as normal outside. Party members can carry the vessel.
Gain a flying speed of 30 feet for 10 minutes.
Roll 2d20 at the end of each long rest (3d20 from 14th level, Greater Portent). Replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check with one of these rolls before the outcome is determined.
Enter bladesong for 1 minute. Gain +INT mod to AC, +10ft walking speed, advantage on Acrobatics, and +INT mod to CON saves to maintain concentration.
Force a creature you can see within 30 feet to reroll a d20 after seeing the result but before the outcome is determined.
Force a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet to make a CON save or be incapacitated until the end of your next turn.
When a creature within 60 feet hits with a weapon attack, increase the velocity: the attack deals an additional 1d10 force damage.
Deal extra force damage equal to half your wizard level when you damage a creature with a wizard spell. Resets to 1 on long rest (increasing when you use Dispel Magic or Counterspell).
Conjure a spectral mind within 60 feet for 10 minutes. You can see and cast spells through it as if you were in its space.
Can take up to 3 legendary actions per round, one per turn after another creature's turn.
If the monster fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Breath weapon recharges on a roll of 5 or 6 on a d6 at the start of the monster's turn.
Breath weapon recharges on a roll of 6 on a d6 at the start of the monster's turn.
